t: 通过"科南十字誓词",印度东方教会切断了自己与殖民葡萄牙人的监护关系.
te: By the Coonan Cross Oath, the Eastern Church in India cuts itself off from colonial Portuguese tutelage.
dz: 通过"科南十字誓词",印度东方教会切断了自己与殖民葡萄牙人的监护关系.
de: By the Coonan Cross Oath, the Eastern Church in India cuts itself off from colonial Portuguese tutelage.

t: 新阿姆斯特丹(后更名为"纽约市")被并入.
te: New Amsterdam (later renamed The City of New York) is incorporated.
dz: 新阿姆斯特丹(后更名为"纽约市")被并入.
de: New Amsterdam (later renamed The City of New York) is incorporated.

t: 奥利弗·克伦威尔解散了英格兰的鲁普议会.
te: Oliver Cromwell dissolves England's Rump Parliament.
dz: 奥利弗·克伦威尔解散了英格兰的鲁普议会.
de: Oliver Cromwell dissolves England's Rump Parliament.

t: 加巴德河之战开始，持续到第二天。
te: The Battle of the Gabbard begins, lasting until the following day.
dz: 第一次英荷战争：加巴德河之战开始，持续到第二天。
de: First Anglo-Dutch War: The Battle of the Gabbard begins, lasting until the following day.

t: The Protection: Oliver Cromwell 成为英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰联邦…
te: The Protectorate: Oliver Cromwell becomes Lord Protector of the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland.
dz: 英语 Interregnum: The Protection: Oliver Cromwell 成为英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰联邦的护法勋爵.
de: English Interregnum: The Protectorate: Oliver Cromwell becomes Lord Protector of the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland.
